notes.title: It's time to get back home - Lust Fantasy 💜 is out now!
notes.content:
We're finally ready to release the game, so don't hesitate to explore this enticing world of magic and intimacy! 

You're an ordinary guy getting his life changed completely as a result of spellcasting going wrong in a different dimension - you get teleported there, and now you must explore this world, solve mysteries, build powerful relationships and find the way home.

 Meet intriguing local people, experience a captivating story, and enjoy beautifully crafted visuals that will pull you into every thrilling moment. Don’t miss your chance to embark on this unforgettable journey full of magic, intrigue, and hot adult encounters! Grab your key, play now and start shaping your own fantasy story!
